verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a product with a public API, MCP server and CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test, or staging environment. The localhost API, local-only mode, self-hosting, separate Channels and export/import into a new identity are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not a product-provided sandbox. The agents skill's "safe way to read, search, and modify Objects" describes acting on real Channel data, not isolated test data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
